_doc: Re-captured evidence for student relations whose sources lacked sha256 and/or a verbatim quote (docs/evidence-whitelist.json). Made by tools/relation_recapture.py on 2026-10-29: each cited url was re-captured (local copy, the cited Wayback id_ url, the API/OAI response, the Wayback capture closest to the original observation, or the live page), its exact bytes hashed (sha256) and stored in relation-captures.sqlite, and a verbatim quote naming the student (and, when names_pi, the PI or the PI's lab) copied from the captured text, whitespace-collapsed; " … " separates two excerpts of the same page in document order. matches_original compares the new hash with the sha256 the source carried.
